name: Fat Donkey 71
author: Christardev
description: Rounded cyan password input that changes colour on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from #d4cbcb to #6ad5f0, the outline is removed, border becomes 4px solid #000000.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Fat Donkey 71</title>
<style>
/* Fat Donkey 71 by Christardev — https://uiverse.io/Christardev/fat-donkey-71 */
.password {
  outline: none;
  max-width: 190px;
  padding: 8px;
  background-color: #d4cbcb;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 4px solid #000000;
  width: auto;
  font-weight: bold;
  font-style: italic;
}

.password:hover {
  background-color: #6ad5f0;
  outline: none;
  border: 4px solid #000000;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input placeholder="Enter  password..." name="text" type="password" class="password">

</body>
</html>
